title: The role of interior design in directing movement within internal spaces to achieve physical distancing and reduce the spread of coronavirus
core_idea: Explore how interior design can direct and regulate user movement and interactions within indoor spaces—using flexible, smart, and sustainable design standards and physical-distancing measures—to create healthier internal environments that limit coronavirus transmission.
tldr: A descriptive theoretical study examining how interior design strategies (flexible, smart, sustainable, and movement-guiding measures) can be applied to enforce physical distancing and enhance health and safety in internal spaces to reduce coronavirus spread.
